name: io.github.java-jaydev/naver-mybox-mcp
title: NAVER MYBOX
description: List, search, download and upload files in a NAVER MYBOX (네이버 마이박스) cloud drive.

environmentVariables.name: MYBOX_PAT
environmentVariables.description: MYBOX personal access token, created in the MYBOX web UI under Settings > account and personal access token management. Falls back to ~/.mybox/token when unset.
